description: Bundleable MNI-space atlases for contact labeling via affine registration. Each atlas is warped from its template space into the patient CT/T1 frame (see rosa_core.registration.register_affine_mi + the LabelmapAtlasProvider affine path), then sampled at each contact. Each entry carries a license_tier: 'permissive' (CC0/CC-BY/MIT/BSD — redistributable commercially) or 'noncommercial' (CC-BY-NC / FreeSurfer — redistributable for NON-COMMERCIAL research only; the shipped bundle is thus non-commercial, matching the FieldTrip/MNE model). All-rights-reserved / registration-gated atlases (THOMAS, Brainnetome) grant no redistribution right and remain bring-your-own. The atlas DATA licenses are independent of the app's code license; keep NOTICE.md with the files.

mni152_2009c_sym.name: MNI ICBM152 2009c Nonlinear Symmetric (T1w, 1mm)
mni152_2009c_sym.license: MNI / Louis Collins BSD-style permissive (redistribution + commercial use granted; retain the copyright notice)
mni152_2009c_sym.attribution: Fonov VS, Evans AC, et al. Unbiased average age-appropriate atlases for pediatric studies. NeuroImage 54(1):313-327 (2011).

mni152_2009a_sym.name: MNI ICBM152 2009a Nonlinear Symmetric (T1w, 2mm)
mni152_2009a_sym.license: MNI / Louis Collins BSD-style permissive (redistribution + commercial use granted; retain the copyright notice)
mni152_2009a_sym.attribution: Fonov VS, Evans AC, et al. Unbiased average age-appropriate atlases for pediatric studies. NeuroImage 54(1):313-327 (2011).
mni152_2009a_sym.provenance: Downsampled from the TemplateFlow res-1 (1mm) T1 to 2mm isotropic and rescaled to uint8 (0-255) to keep it small; intensity structure preserved for MI registration. The thalamus_mial atlas is on the native 1mm 2009a-sym grid and warps through the same affine transform.

mni152_nlin6_sym.name: MNI ICBM152 Nonlinear 6th-gen (FSL, T1w, 2mm)
mni152_nlin6_sym.attribution: Grabner G, et al.; FSL MNI152 6th-generation nonlinear template. Redistributed via TemplateFlow tpl-MNI152NLin6Asym.
mni152_nlin6_sym.provenance: TemplateFlow res-02 (2mm) T1, rescaled to uint8. Shared by the schaefer + harvard_oxford atlases (both FSL MNI152 2mm space).

cerebra.name: CerebrA
cerebra.long_name: Cerebrum Atlas (whole-brain): Mindboggle DKT cortical + manually-corrected subcortical
cerebra.coverage: whole-brain: 102 labels (51 per hemisphere) — cortical DKT gyri plus thalamus, caudate, putamen, pallidum, hippocampus, amygdala, accumbens, ventral diencephalon, basal forebrain, cerebellum GM/WM, vermal lobules, brainstem, ventricles.
cerebra.license: CC0-1.0 (public-domain dedication of the atlas data)
cerebra.attribution: Manera AL, Dadar M, Fonov V, Collins DL. CerebrA, registration and the human brain atlas. Scientific Data 7:237 (2020).
cerebra.provenance: Upstream CerebrA.nii is float32 (193x229x193, 1mm); bundled copy recast to uint8 (max label 102) and gzipped. Label values and the affine are byte-for-byte preserved; only the storage dtype changed. lut fetched from the same repo's CerebrA_LabelDetails.csv.

thalamus_mial.name: Thalamic nuclei (MIAL)
thalamus_mial.long_name: Probabilistic atlas of the thalamic nuclei (Najdenovska/MIAL) — 7 subparts per hemisphere
thalamus_mial.coverage: thalamus only: 14 labels (7 nuclei per hemisphere) — pulvinar, anterior, medio-dorsal, ventral latero-dorsal, central-lateral/lateral-posterior/medial-pulvinar, ventral anterior, ventral latero-ventral. Complements CerebrA's single whole-thalamus label. Contacts outside the thalamus read Unknown.
thalamus_mial.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (atlas data on Zenodo). ShareAlike: keep the license with the files; ship the labelmap unmodified except the dtype recast noted below.
thalamus_mial.attribution: Najdenovska E, Aleman-Gomez Y, et al. In-vivo probabilistic atlas of human thalamic nuclei based on diffusion-weighted MRI. Scientific Data 5:180270 (2018). Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.1405484.
thalamus_mial.provenance: Upstream MaxProb map (197x233x189, 1mm, MNI152 2009a nonlinear symmetric) recast to uint8 (max label 14) and gzipped; label values + affine preserved. LUT is the upstream Thalamic_Nuclei-ColorLUT.txt (FreeSurfer-format).

harvard_oxford.name: Harvard-Oxford
harvard_oxford.coverage: cortical (48 gyri, maxprob thr25) plus 15 subcortical structures (thalamus, caudate, putamen, pallidum, hippocampus, amygdala, accumbens per hemisphere + brainstem). Classic anatomical labels; overlaps CerebrA's coverage.
harvard_oxford.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (FSL Harvard-Oxford atlas). ShareAlike: keep this notice with the files.
harvard_oxford.attribution: Harvard-Oxford atlas, FSL / Harvard Center for Morphometric Analysis (Makris, Goldstein, Kennedy et al.). Distributed with FSL.
harvard_oxford.provenance: Cortical + subcortical maxprob-thr25 (2mm) from nilearn/FSL, merged into one uint8 labelmap (cortical 1-48 kept; true subcortical structures added as 49-63, excluding the WM/cortex/ventricle filler labels). Index-name TSV LUT generated from the nilearn label lists.

schaefer.name: Schaefer2018 (400/7)
schaefer.long_name: Schaefer 2018 local-global functional cortical parcellation — 400 parcels, 7 networks
schaefer.coverage: cortex only: 400 fine functional parcels grouped into 7 Yeo networks (e.g. 7Networks_LH_Vis_1). For research-grade functional-network localization; not anatomical gyrus names. Subcortical/deep contacts read Unknown.
schaefer.license: MIT-style (Schaefer/Yeo CBIG). Redistribution + commercial use permitted with attribution.
schaefer.attribution: Schaefer A, Kong R, Gordon EM, Laumann TO, Zuo XN, Holmes AJ, Eickhoff SB, Yeo BTT. Local-Global Parcellation of the Human Cerebral Cortex. Cerebral Cortex 28:3095-3114 (2018).
schaefer.provenance: nilearn/CBIG 400x7 labelmap (2mm, FSL MNI152) as uint16 (400 > 255) + gzipped; index-name TSV LUT from the nilearn label list.

thalamus_iglesias.name: Thalamic nuclei (FreeSurfer/Iglesias)
thalamus_iglesias.long_name: FreeSurfer thalamic nuclei (Iglesias 2018) — 26 nuclei per hemisphere, max-prob
thalamus_iglesias.coverage: thalamus only: 52 labels (26 nuclei per hemisphere — AV, VA, VLa/VLp, VPL, VM, CM, MD, Pf, Pulvinar subdivisions, LGN, MGN, CeM, CL, Pc, LD, LP, ...). Finer than thalamus_mial's 7 subparts; the gold-standard thalamic nuclei atlas. Distance-gated; contacts outside the thalamus read Unknown.
thalamus_iglesias.license: FreeSurfer Software License (permissive Part-A/B grant; retain the MGH notice). NON-COMMERCIAL bundle: usable for research; a commercial distribution should confirm the atlas-data terms with MGH.
thalamus_iglesias.attribution: Iglesias JE, Insausti R, Lerma-Usabiaga G, et al. A probabilistic atlas of the human thalamic nuclei combining ex vivo MRI and histology. NeuroImage 183:314-326 (2018).
thalamus_iglesias.provenance: FreeSurfer ThalamusProbs.MNIsymSpace (4D probability maps, 0.5mm, MNI152 2009c symmetric, cropped to the thalamus) argmaxed to a discrete max-prob labelmap (uint8); LUT names from the shipped names.txt (FreeSurfer thalamic-nuclei IDs).

suit_cerebellum.name: Cerebellum (SUIT/Diedrichsen)
suit_cerebellum.long_name: SUIT probabilistic cerebellar atlas (Diedrichsen 2009) — lobules + deep nuclei
suit_cerebellum.coverage: cerebellum only: 34 labels — lobules (I-IV, V, VI, CrusI/II, VIIb, VIIIa/b, IX, X, split L/R + vermis) plus deep nuclei (dentate, interposed, fastigial). Distance-gated; SEEG rarely targets cerebellum, so most contacts read Unknown.
suit_cerebellum.license: CC BY-NC 3.0 (Diedrichsen lab). NON-COMMERCIAL: bundle with attribution + this notice; do not use commercially.
suit_cerebellum.attribution: Diedrichsen J, Balsters JH, Flavell J, Cussans E, Ramnani N. A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum. NeuroImage 46(1):39-46 (2009).
suit_cerebellum.provenance: space-MNI (FSL MNI152) discrete dseg recast to uint8; index-name TSV LUT derived from atl-Anatom.tsv (color column dropped).
